title: Sweet Potato Pie

items.item: sweet potatoes, or 1 cup mashed from a larger can

instructions: With your can opener, open the can of sweet potatoes. Pour into a strainer over the sink to drain out all of the liquid.
Place the sweet potatoes in a medium mixing bowl. Mash them with the back of a fork or a potato masher.
Add the soy milk, brown sugar, flour, eggs, cinnamon, and salt.
With an electric mixer at medium speed, mix all the ingredients until the mixture becomes a smooth batter.
Place the pie crust on a cookie sheet, put it in the hot oven, and bake for 10 minutes.
Turn the oven temperature down to 350°F and bake for another 40 minutes.
Carefully remove the sweet potato pie from the oven. Slice and serve.
